name: Jacques Martin
biography: Grandfather, 72, travels with the family on holidays. Needs easy boarding and a comfortable, calm seat.

name: Camille Martin
biography: Driver and mother of two. Drives the family on weekends and holidays. Wants the car to handle the logistics so she can stay focused on the road.

name: Léa Martin
biography: 11 years old, sits in the second row. Gets bored after 30 minutes. Loves games and her own music.

name: Hugo Bernard
biography: Camille's partner, works remotely. Uses long stops to rest or answer a few emails. Front passenger.
